meta.topStoryHeadline: Dance Theatre of Harlem Names Inaugural Artistic Council
meta.topStorySummary: Dance Theatre of Harlem announced its first-ever Artistic Council, bringing together Derrick Adams, Sanford Biggers, Virginia Johnson, Fatima Robinson, Marcus Samuelsson, Mickalene Thomas, and other Black cultural figures to help shape the company's creative vision.
executiveSummary: Dance Theatre of Harlem announced its inaugural Artistic Council, expanding the company's creative circle with major Black cultural leaders across dance, visual art, food, and public culture.

The Smithsonian remains one of the biggest arts-policy stories to watch this month, with proposed federal budget cuts and renewed pressure on museum programming raising questions about cultural independence.

In New York, Harlem Week, Studio Museum exhibitions, Dance Theatre of Harlem, the Charlie Parker Jazz Festival, and the Brooklyn Caribbean Literary Festival anchor the calendar from mid-August into September.
